name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. domain=spell, descriptor encodes spell_id=7 (a meaningful FD2 spell ID in range 00h-23h, NOT an address residual) and the animation variant (full_screen_flash). The _7_ matches the hardcoded literal PUSH 0x7 in the body and the dispatch-table index 7 (data xref 0x51D1D holds this fn's address). Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Spell dispatch thunk for spell_id=7: delegates to the full-screen-flash offensive-spell worker with the spell_id hardcoded.
logic_summary: Thin dispatch entry registered at index 7 of the spell dispatch table (@ 0x51D01). After a stack-probe (__CHK 0x14), it forwards the three incoming args (caster, num_targets, target_id_array) plus the literal spell_id=7 to fd2_execute_offensive_full_screen_flash_spell. In FD2.LE the body shares the {PUSH caster + CALL worker + cleanup + RET} tail of sibling anchor fd2_spell_handler_id_4_via_full_screen_flash @ 0x21396 (JMP 0x213AA); siblings ids 4-7 form the full-screen-flash family. Net effect: fd2_execute_offensive_full_screen_flash_spell(caster, 7, num_targets, target_id_array).

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; passed through unchanged to the worker as the casting unit.
params.reason: Descriptive, no address residual; matches body usage (forwarded as caster_unit_id).

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of target units; passed through unchanged to the worker.
params.reason: Clear abbreviation of num_targets; no address residual; matches body usage.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the array of target unit ids; cast to int and forwarded to the worker.
params.reason: Descriptive (target id array); no address residual; matches body usage (target_id_array).

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the spell execution side-effect via the worker.
